Welcome home to this beautifully designed 2023-Mystique home by Pulte Homes. If you're looking for a new home with a great floor plan, tons of upgrades, in a luxurious highly sought out community, then why wait to build when you can move right into this better-than-new home. Offering modern design, privacy, and plenty of space to live and entertain, this exceptional property is ready to welcome you home!
This home offers 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a dedicated flex room, and 2,184 sf of thoughtfully designed living space. With modern finishes and an open-concept layout, this home combines comfort, style, and functionality.
Step inside to discover a spacious extended gathering room featuring a custom accent wall and tray ceiling, seamlessly flowing into the chef-inspired gourmet kitchen with upgraded cabinetry, granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, a large center island with additional storage, and an inviting cafe area—perfect for entertaining family and friends.
The flex room provides the ideal space for a private office to work from home, a playroom, or a room to fit your lifestyle. This desirable split bedroom and bath design provides privacy for family and guests with 2 additional bedrooms and a full bath with tiled tub/shower and granite countertop vanity. Spacious laundry room includes a washer and dryer, as well as a folding area. Entry from the garage features a convenient drop zone, which has endless opportunities. The 2-car garage has been upgraded as well with Swisstrax™ lifetime modular flooring.  Additional home features include 8’ tall interior doors, a tankless hot water heater, and hurricane shutters. 
The generous owner’s suite offers a beautiful custom accent wall as well as a large walk-in closet. The owner’s suite bath has granite countertops, double bowl vanity, and an extended walk-in shower with frameless glass.
Enjoy Florida living year-round from the extended covered lanai, where you will appreciate peaceful views and the privacy of no rear neighbors. The beautifully maintained yard and attractive curb appeal make this home truly move-in ready.
A vibrant calendar of community events enhances the neighborhood’s welcoming atmosphere. Take advantage of the abundant recreational activities and events including 3 amenity centers with resort style pools, a dog park, and top-rated schools. Camp Creek features clubhouse, cafe, game room, pickleball and a swim center with plunge pool and water slide. Brightwood Pavilion includes a resident clubhouse, resort style pool, state-of-the-art fitness center, game room, and playground. Riverfield Verandah features a resort style pool and covered outdoor patio.  Conveniently located just minutes from top-rated schools which include Barbara A. Harvey K-8, a brand-new Campus right in the community (will be expanding to include middle school by 2028 school year), Buffalo Creek Middle School, and Parrish Community High School!  Minutes from the recently opened HCA Florida North River Ranch Emergency and Market Walk with access to coffee shops, dining options, Publix Super Market, dentists and more! Easy access to I-75 and Highway 301. Only a short drive to the city of Tampa, St. Petersburg, Sarasota, and the beautiful Gulf Coast beaches. Don’t miss your opportunity to own this like-new, move-in ready home—schedule your private showing today!

villages.aboutVillageDescription:
Tucked amid the peaceful green spaces of Parrish, Florida, Broadleaf by SimplyDwell Homes offers a fresh take on attainable new‑construction living - just minutes from I‑75 and the white‑sand Gulf beaches. 

Community life centers on Broadleaf’s inviting outdoor amenities. An event lawn and covered pavilion host food‑truck nights and neighborhood socials, while a shaded playground, cornhole courts, and hopscotch keep kids busy. Leash up at the fenced dog park, jog the walkable streets lined with native landscaping, or unwind under string‑lit patios. Broadleaf is designed to foster easy connections and everyday fun.

Homebuyers can choose from a collection of single‑family floor plans ranging from roughly 1,300 to 2,600 square feet with 2 to 5 bedrooms, open‑concept layouts, and two‑car garages - delivering style and practicality from the mid‑$300s. With no costly CDD fees and modest HOA dues, Broadleaf lets you maximize value while enjoying brand‑new construction peace of mind.

Beyond the neighborhood, top‑rated schools, new shopping centers, and the Ellenton Premium Outlets are all close by, as are boat launches along the Manatee River for weekends on the water. Broadleaf’s blend of affordability, modern design, and laid‑back Florida lifestyle makes it a standout place to plant roots.

The community’s amenity-rich core includes multiple clubhouses and resort‑style pools with water features like water slides and lazy rivers.
